entries.title: Merge duplicate parts
entries.description: Combine a duplicate part into the part you want to keep, preserving stock value, bills of materials and changes to sent purchase orders.

entries.title: Scan printed labels more easily
entries.description: Part labels now use larger QR codes, with the name and location alongside them and the part code underneath.

entries.title: Print part labels from Inventory
entries.description: Print labels individually or in batches from Stock on hand, or print a label from a part’s history page. Users with Inventory access can now print labels without needing access to Parts.
